objective: Complete commercial launch while keeping security, billing, customer history and provider integrations evidence-backed.
status_summary: Master b58ca601 contains merged commercial code; GitHub CD successfully deployed the Vercel frontend on 2026-10-08. The public website and Railway backend pass latest scheduled external health checks and Railway has 1/1 live replicas. Commercial launch is NOT verified: historical secret scan remains red, live HighLevel/Resend provisioning and signed paid-customer E2E are blocked/unverified, and cron/alert configuration is unresolved. Direct Vercel team access currently returns HTTP 403. Railway's competing source-triggered builds fail at snapshot, without evidence of an outage on the surviving deployment.

latest_verified_milestone.description: On master b58ca601 GitHub CD 37718659340 passed Vercel environment sync, database migrations, storage probe, and frontend deployment; Railway deploy appropriately skipped on frontend-only diff. Scheduled production health run 37898737171 succeeded on 2026-10-09; Railway runtime independently reports 1/1 replicas online. This verifies operational availability, not commercial acceptance.

Resend production sender/domain authorization and successful authorized email delivery remain unverified.

Live checkout links/product mapping, signed paid webhook intake, subscription/entitlement/credit correctness and full purchase-to-return-account acceptance remain unverified; do not enable live payments without approval.

Direct Vercel project inspection fails HTTP 403 for team scope; GitHub CD success is verified but direct project environment/alias inspection is blocked.

deployment.summary: CD on 2026-10-08 successfully synced Vercel environment, ran DB migrations, verified storage, deployed frontend; Railway leg skipped on frontend-only change. No complete paid-journey acceptance receipt.

Paid deep scans consume credits and persist sanitized report history.
Saved sites, tenant isolation, monitoring and retention are enforced.
Live checkout grants correct entitlement through signed provider webhook.
Customer receives access/email and can complete a paid journey without manual intervention.

risks: Provider-console authorization is the critical launch dependency.
Cost harness observed zero reported LLM usage on six verification runs; treat this as an instrumentation gap, not proof of zero model cost.
Railway source and CLI deploy modes are incompatible on one moving branch; source is pinned to prevent duplicate auto-deploy races.
Historical Slack credential must not be broadly suppressed before revocation evidence.
Railway GitHub-source deploy attempts fail snapshot while GitHub CD pipeline remains operational; latest FAILED label must not be confused with currently active service health.
Scheduled GitHub health workflow configured every 15 minutes actually runs with multi-hour gaps on 2026-10-08/09; passing executions do not prove continuous monitoring.
Direct Vercel API scope 403 prevents independent configuration verification; keep production configuration as unknown, not healthy by assumption.
Historical gitleaks incident must remain unsuppressed until revocation is proven.
